title: Judge Gift Cards 2018: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: A rare find, suitable for the most discerning collector.
"I can tell you what you wish to know. But first, there is the matter of my fee."
"Your body is a delicate instrument that tells me truths. These devices help me 'tune' that instrument."
It harmonizes with the essence of its master.
"Someday, when the world is safe again, my homeland will return." —Teferi
A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.
Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.
Every predator is something else's prey.
